verdict.rationale: Clerky provides a controlled, template-based workflow for drafting startup legal paperwork. Users can customize key terms or swap the underlying forms, collaborate on document sets in real time, loop in attorneys to review and comment, assign reviewer or observer roles, and see a full change log. There is no evidence of counterparty negotiation or true redlining, so the workflow covers drafting and internal review more than contract negotiation. Missing for 10: redlining/tracked-changes markup, counterparty negotiation workflow, support for general commercial contracts beyond formation/equity/hiring paperwork, independent hands-on corroboration of review workflows.
